sources.entry: Monitor Bar - Monitor Bar app supports three modes, compact, normal, extra. It monitors battery, Disk, Memory, CPU, Network bandwidth, Wi-Fi.

summary.one_liner: Monitor Bar is a macOS menu bar app that shows system stats (battery, disk, memory, CPU, network bandwidth, Wi-Fi) in an Airline-style status bar.
summary.what_it_does: Monitor Bar displays system monitoring information in the macOS menu bar. According to the README, it monitors battery, disk, memory, CPU, network bandwidth, and Wi-Fi. It offers three display modes: compact, normal, and extra. The styling is described as inspired by the vim-airline statusline plugin and the bobthefish fish shell theme. The README includes a screenshot showing all three modes together, though no further details about configuration are given.
use_cases: monitor cpu and memory usage from the menu bar
check battery level on a mac
watch network bandwidth in real time
see disk space at a glance
view wi-fi status in the menu bar
customize how much system info is shown in the menu bar
notable: Three display modes: compact, normal, and extra
Combines battery, disk, memory, CPU, network bandwidth, and Wi-Fi in one bar
Styling inspired by vim-airline and the bobthefish fish theme
caveats: README lists only Sonoma 14.1.2 as supported, on Apple silicon and Intel
